basis: Current user instruction removes duration and count limits for non-Bashar material. Bashar retains a five-minute minimum, including reposts on mixed accounts. Historical selection snapshots remain unchanged.
unknown_duration: Inventory the item; measure actual media duration before applying the Bashar threshold. Do not infer duration from title or omit unknowns from the discovery ledger.
unknown_speaker: Keep provisional source/account attribution; do not turn a mixed account biography into a per-utterance speaker annotation.
resource_policy: Resume finite discovered frames subject to verified per-item storage and integrity checks. A resource stop is recorded as incomplete acquisition, never as a complete channel census.
